title: Monero GUI wallet files
whyItMatters: Monero wallet files hold the encrypted keys and transaction history. The keys in a wallet file plus its password are the funds.
source: Monero Docs, monero-wallet-gui reference: the wallet is created in $HOME/Monero/wallets by default: https://docs.getmonero.org/interacting/monero-wallet-gui-reference
notes: The GUI wizard can put wallets in ~/.bitmonero/wallets instead, and this rule does not check there. The wallet list, config and log are in ~/.config/monero-project and the blockchain data in ~/.bitmonero, neither of which is counted here.

cleanup.exportFirst: In the Monero GUI, confirm the 25-word seed of every wallet is written down, or copy the wallet files to a device you keep.
steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup for each wallet.
Copy any wallet file you still need to a backup device.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Deletes the wallet files with their keys and transaction history on this computer. Without the seed or a backup the funds are lost.
cleanup.source: Monero Docs, Monero GUI wallet reference: https://docs.getmonero.org/interacting/monero-wallet-gui-reference
